The camera and detection pause while Settings is open. Use Home to return to detection.

Known people manages saved face profiles. Voice alerts turns spoken object and hazard alerts on or off. Haptic alerts control vibrations independently; choose intensity or Urgent only, and use Test haptics to preview every vibration. Auto torch enables the 25-second torch cycle. Pocket touch lock ignores camera-screen touches while the proximity sensor is covered; detection continues. The camera brightness threshold applies when Android does not provide a usable rear light sensor; higher values make the camera fallback treat dimmer scenes as dark sooner.

Use Mode: Objects for the usual object and known-person detection, or Mode: Road for pothole detection. Triple tap the camera preview for one Gemini scene description. Scene analysis sends a still image only.
Keep detection running in the background

Some phones may stop background apps to save battery. For more reliable camera alerts, review Android battery optimization and your phone’s background or autostart settings. Drishti cannot override manufacturer restrictions automatically.
